cc:Work.dc:title: reader-f14a-normal
cc:Work.dc:description: Five action families with four inclusion arrows. Score-tie coarsenings are contained in fixed-order capped reports, then all capped reports, then all ordered partitions. Exact-G reports are also contained in capped reports; they are not generally nested with fixed-order reports. The order refines the score order, and inclusion need not be strict.
